label: persistent
definition: A shedability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's remaining attached to the plant after the time at which comparable structures are usually shed. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001731 deciduous (plant) and FLOPO:0991181 marcescent; PATO:0001732 non-deciduous (any body part) inheres in the whole plant, not the part.
reason: Persistent (stipules, indumentum, calyx) is a core flora quality with no term: botanical_terminology lists it as unmapped. Later batches should use this class for 'persistent'.

label: rheophytic
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing in the beds of swift-flowing streams and rivers, within reach of regular flooding. NOTE: Probably outside PATO's scope (where an organism lives); kept in FLOPO beside FLOPO:0991112 aquatic and FLOPO:0991110 epiphytic.
reason: A recognised habitat class of plants (van Steenis) of the same kind as the accepted epiphytic, terrestrial and aquatic, with no term.
